--!strict
-- BasePad.luau — assigns one pad per playing player on the reef ring, owns the
-- safe-zone check, the collector display above each pad, respawn-on-fall, and
-- spawn placement on the ground at entry.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Data = require(script.Parent.data)
local World = require(script.Parent.World)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)

local BasePad = {
	ownerOfSlot = {} :: { [number]: Player },
	slotOfPlayer = {} :: { [Player]: number },
	collectors = {} :: { [Player]: Model },
	lastOwnedCount = {} :: { [Player]: number },
}

local SAFE_TAG = "SafeZone"

local function padCFrame(slot: number): CFrame
	local pos = World.padSlotPosition(slot)
	return CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
end

local function stylePad(slot: number, player: Player): ()
	local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild(`PadSlot{slot}`)
	if pad == nil or not pad:IsA("Part") then
		return
	end
	pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 170)
	pad.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	pad.Name = `Pad_{player.Name}`

	-- a little name sign on the pad
	local sign = Instance.new("Part")
	sign.Name = "PadSign"
	sign.Anchored = true
	sign.CanCollide = false
	sign.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1.6, 0.3)
	sign.CFrame = padCFrame(slot) * CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
	sign.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 60)
	sign.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	sign.Parent = workspace
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Brightness = 3
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 230)
	label.Text = `{player.Name}'s pad — safe from the Tide`
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = sign

	-- invisible safe-zone cylinder above the pad
	local zone = Instance.new("Part")
	zone.Name = SAFE_TAG
	zone.Anchored = true
	zone.CanCollide = false
	zone.Transparency = 1
	zone.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	zone.Size = Vector3.new(24, Data.TUNING.padRadius * 2, Data.TUNING.padRadius * 2)
	zone.CFrame = padCFrame(slot) * CFrame.new(0, Data.TUNING.padRadius, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
	zone.Parent = workspace
end

local function clearCollector(player: Player): ()
	local old = BasePad.collectors[player]
	if old ~= nil then
		old:Destroy()
		BasePad.collectors[player] = nil
	end
end

-- Rebuilds the floating collector stack above the player's pad from their profile.
function BasePad.refreshCollector(player: Player): ()
	clearCollector(player)
	local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
	if #profile.owned == 0 then
		return
	end
	local slot = BasePad.slotOfPlayer[player]
	if slot == nil then
		return
	end
	local pos = World.padSlotPosition(slot)

	-- stack one built model per owned brainrot (bounded: maxOwnedPerTier * tiers)
	local stack = Instance.new("Model")
	stack.Name = `Collector_{player.Name}`
	local y = 3
	local shown = 0
	for _, o in profile.owned do
		if shown >= 10 then
			break -- keep the pad readable; the HUD list shows the rest
		end
		local tier = Data.tier(o.tier)
		local model = World.buildBrainrot(tier, o.mutation)
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y + y, pos.Z))
		model.Parent = stack
		y += 1.6
		shown += 1
	end
	if shown == 0 then
		stack:Destroy()
		return
	end
	-- floating cash counter above the stack
	local primary = Instance.new("Part")
	primary.Name = "CounterAnchor"
	primary.Anchored = true
	primary.CanCollide = false
	primary.Transparency = 1
	primary.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
	primary.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos.X, pos.Y + y + 1.2, pos.Z)
	primary.Parent = stack
	stack.PrimaryPart = primary
	World.buildCounter(stack, "+" .. tostring(math.floor(Economy.rateOf(profile))) .. "/s")
	stack.Parent = workspace
	BasePad.collectors[player] = stack
end

function BasePad.assign(player: Player): ()
	if BasePad.slotOfPlayer[player] ~= nil then
		return
	end
	-- first free slot, else round-robin
	local slot: number? = nil
	for i = 1, World.PAD_SLOTS do
		if BasePad.ownerOfSlot[i] == nil then
			slot = i
			break
		end
	end
	if slot == nil then
		slot = ((#Players:GetPlayers() - 1) % World.PAD_SLOTS) + 1
	end
	BasePad.slotOfSlotFix(slot, player)
	stylePad(slot, player)
	BasePad.refreshCollector(player)
end

function BasePad.slotOfSlotFix(slot: number, player: Player): ()
	BasePad.ownerOfSlot[slot] = player
	BasePad.slotOfPlayer[player] = slot
end

function BasePad.release(player: Player): ()
	local slot = BasePad.slotOfPlayer[player]
	if slot ~= nil then
		BasePad.ownerOfSlot[slot] = nil
	end
	BasePad.slotOfPlayer[player] = nil
	BasePad.lastOwnedCount[player] = nil
	clearCollector(player)
	-- reset the pad visual
	local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild(`Pad_{player.Name}`)
	if pad ~= nil and pad:IsA("Part") then
		pad.Name = `PadSlot{slot or 1}`
		pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
		pad.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
	end
end

function BasePad.slotOf(player: Player): number?
	return BasePad.slotOfPlayer[player]
end

-- True when the player's root is inside their own pad safe zone.
function BasePad.isOnOwnPad(player: Player): boolean
	local slot = BasePad.slotOfPlayer[player]
	if slot == nil then
		return false
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root == nil or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false
	end
	local center = World.padSlotPosition(slot)
	local dx = root.Position.X - center.X
	local dz = root.Position.Z - center.Z
	local dy = root.Position.Y - (center.Y + 1)
	return (dx * dx + dz * dz) <= Data.TUNING.padRadius * Data.TUNING.padRadius and math.abs(dy) <= Data.TUNING.padRadius
end

-- Places a character ON the ground at their pad (or the gate at entry). Never in the sky.
function BasePad.spawnCharacter(player: Player): ()
	local char = player.Character
	if char == nil then
		return
	end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root == nil or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local slot = BasePad.slotOfPlayer[player]
	local pos: Vector3
	if slot ~= nil then
		local p = World.padSlotPosition(slot)
		pos = Vector3.new(p.X, World.WALK_TOP + 1, p.Z)
	else
		pos = World.spawnPoint + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	end
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if humanoid ~= nil and humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") then
		humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
	end
end

function BasePad.start(): ()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		BasePad.assign(player)
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			BasePad.spawnCharacter(player)
		end)
		if player.Character ~= nil then
			BasePad.spawnCharacter(player)
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		BasePad.release(player)
	end)

	-- Falling into the water respawns the player on their own pad (no kill plane),
	-- and the collector stack refreshes when the owned count changes (buy/rebirth/orb).
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.5)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				local char = player.Character
				local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if root ~= nil and root:IsA("BasePart") then
					if root.Position.Y < World.WATER_Y + 1 then
						BasePad.spawnCharacter(player)
					end
				end
				local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
				local count = #profile.owned
				if BasePad.lastOwnedCount[player] ~= count then
					BasePad.lastOwnedCount[player] = count
					BasePad.refreshCollector(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return BasePad

--!strict
-- Economy.luau — per-player cash, owned brainrots, purchases and the cash tick.
-- The server never trusts numbers from the client: every RemoteEvent validates its args.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Data = require(script.Parent.data)
local World = require(script.Parent.World)

type MutationId = Data.MutationId

export type Owned = {
	tier: number,
	mutation: MutationId,
}

export type Profile = {
	cash: number,
	owned: { Owned },
	rebirths: number,
	cashMultiplier: number, -- 1 + rebirths * (rebirthMultiplier - 1) style, kept across rebirth
	totalEarned: number,
}

local TUNING = Data.TUNING

local Economy = {
	profiles = {} :: { [Player]: Profile },
	remotes = {} :: { [string]: RemoteEvent },
}

local function makeRemotes(): { [string]: RemoteEvent }
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if folder == nil then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "Remotes"
		folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	local out: { [string]: RemoteEvent } = {}
	for _, name in { "BuyBrainrot", "Rebirth", "State", "CashTick", "TideState", "OrbTaken" } do
		local r = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if r == nil or not r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
			r.Name = name
			r.Parent = folder
		end
		out[name] = r :: RemoteEvent
	end
	return out
end

Economy.remotes = makeRemotes()

local function newProfile(): Profile
	return {
		cash = TUNING.startCash,
		owned = {},
		rebirths = 0,
		cashMultiplier = 1,
		totalEarned = 0,
	}
end

function Economy.profileOf(player: Player): Profile
	local p = Economy.profiles[player]
	if p == nil then
		p = newProfile()
		Economy.profiles[player] = p
	end
	return p
end

function Economy.ownedCount(profile: Profile): number
	return #profile.owned
end

-- Income per second across every owned brainrot (tier rate * mutation * rebirth multiplier).
function Economy.rateOf(profile: Profile): number
	local sum = 0
	for _, o in profile.owned do
		local tier = Data.tier(o.tier)
		local mutation = Data.mutation(o.mutation)
		sum += tier.rate * mutation.multiplier
	end
	return sum * profile.cashMultiplier
end

function Economy.addCash(profile: Profile, amount: number): number
	profile.cash += amount
	profile.totalEarned += amount
	return profile.cash
end

local function validateTierId(v: unknown): number?
	if typeof(v) ~= "number" then
		return nil
	end
	local id = math.floor(v)
	if id < 1 or id > Data.MAX_TIER then
		return nil
	end
	return id
end

-- Rate-limited, validated purchase. Returns true when the purchase happened.
local lastBuyAt: { [Player]: number } = {}
local BUY_COOLDOWN = 0.25

function Economy.tryBuy(player: Player, tierIdRaw: unknown): boolean
	local tierId = validateTierId(tierIdRaw)
	if tierId == nil then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if (lastBuyAt[player] or 0) + BUY_COOLDOWN > now then
		return false
	end
	-- purchases happen at the fountain (design law), not from anywhere
	if not World.nearFountain(player) then
		return false
	end
	local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
	local ownedOfTier = 0
	for _, o in profile.owned do
		if o.tier == tierId then
			ownedOfTier += 1
		end
	end
	if ownedOfTier >= TUNING.maxOwnedPerTier then
		return false
	end
	local cost = Data.costOf(tierId, ownedOfTier)
	if profile.cash < cost then
		return false
	end
	lastBuyAt[player] = now
	profile.cash -= cost
	local mutation = Data.rollMutation()
	table.insert(profile.owned, { tier = tierId, mutation = mutation.id })
	Economy.broadcastState(player)
	return true
end

function Economy.tryRebirth(player: Player): boolean
	local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
	if #profile.owned < TUNING.rebirthAtOwned then
		return false
	end
	profile.rebirths += 1
	-- keeps a cash-rate multiplier and resets the base
	profile.cashMultiplier = 1 + profile.rebirths * (Data.TUNING.rebirthMultiplier - 1)
	profile.owned = {}
	profile.cash = math.max(profile.cash, TUNING.startCash)
	Economy.broadcastState(player)
	return true
end

function Economy.serialize(profile: Profile): { any }
	local owned: { any } = {}
	for i, o in profile.owned do
		owned[i] = { tier = o.tier, mutation = o.mutation }
	end
	return {
		cash = profile.cash,
		rate = Economy.rateOf(profile),
		owned = owned,
		rebirths = profile.rebirths,
		cashMultiplier = profile.cashMultiplier,
		totalEarned = profile.totalEarned,
	}
end

function Economy.broadcastState(player: Player): ()
	local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
	Economy.remotes.State:FireClient(player, Economy.serialize(profile))
end

function Economy.broadcastAll(): ()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		Economy.broadcastState(player)
	end
end

function Economy.start(): ()
	Economy.remotes.BuyBrainrot.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, tierIdRaw)
		Economy.tryBuy(player, tierIdRaw)
	end)
	Economy.remotes.Rebirth.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		Economy.tryRebirth(player)
	end)
	Economy.remotes.State.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		Economy.broadcastState(player)
	end)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		Economy.profileOf(player)
		Economy.broadcastState(player)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		Economy.profiles[player] = nil
		lastBuyAt[player] = nil
	end)

	-- Cash ticks once per second per player; the client also gets a tick payload
	-- so its floating counter can animate smoothly.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local dt = task.wait(TUNING.cashTick)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				local profile = Economy.profiles[player]
				if profile ~= nil then
					local rate = Economy.rateOf(profile)
					if rate > 0 then
						Economy.addCash(profile, rate * dt)
					end
					Economy.remotes.CashTick:FireClient(player, profile.cash, rate)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Economy

--!strict
-- Rebirth.luau — rebirth at 8 brainrots owned: keeps a cash-rate multiplier and
-- resets the base. The actual purchase logic lives in Economy (validated there);
-- this module watches profiles and refreshes pad collectors after a rebirth.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Data = require(script.Parent.data)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)
local BasePad = require(script.Parent.BasePad)

local TUNING = Data.TUNING

local Rebirth = {}

function Rebirth.canRebirth(player: Player): boolean
	local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
	return #profile.owned >= TUNING.rebirthAtOwned
end

function Rebirth.start(): ()
	-- After every state broadcast, if a rebirth happened the collector was already
	-- refreshed by Economy; here we just keep a light watchdog so pads stay in sync
	-- (bounded loop, no decoration work inside any touch handler).
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(2)
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
				if profile.rebirths > 0 and BasePad.slotOf(player) ~= nil then
					-- collector refresh is idempotent and cheap; only when the pad is empty
					-- (right after a rebirth) do we rebuild
					if BasePad.collectors[player] == nil and #profile.owned > 0 then
						BasePad.refreshCollector(player)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return Rebirth

--!strict
-- TideCycle.luau — "The Tide": every 90 s a tsunami wall sweeps the reef after a
-- 10 s klaxon. Players caught off their own pad lose their two rarest brainrots,
-- which fly up as collectible orbs for 15 s; anyone can grab them.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Data = require(script.Parent.data)
local World = require(script.Parent.World)
local BasePad = require(script.Parent.BasePad)
local Economy = require(script.Parent.Economy)

local TUNING = Data.TUNING

local TideCycle = {
	phase = "calm" :: "calm" | "warning" | "sweep",
	timeLeft = TUNING.tidePeriod,
	wall = nil :: Part?,
	orbs = {} :: { { model: Model, owner: Player, tier: number, mutation: Data.MutationId, expiresAt: number } },
}

local function makeWall(): Part
	local wall = Instance.new("Part")
	wall.Name = "TideWall"
	wall.Anchored = true
	wall.CanCollide = false
	wall.Transparency = 0.25
	wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 255)
	wall.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	wall.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	wall.Parent = workspace
	return wall
end

local function setPhase(phase: "calm" | "warning" | "sweep", timeLeft: number): ()
	TideCycle.phase = phase
	TideCycle.timeLeft = timeLeft
	Economy.remotes.TideState:FireAllClients(phase, timeLeft, TUNING.tidePeriod)
end

-- Two rarest = highest tier ids; ties broken by mutation multiplier.
local function twoRarest(profile: Economy.Profile): { Economy.Owned }
	local sorted = table.clone(profile.owned)
	table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
		if a.tier ~= b.tier then
			return a.tier > b.tier
		end
		return Data.mutation(a.mutation).multiplier > Data.mutation(b.mutation).multiplier
	end)
	return { sorted[1], sorted[2] }
end

local function spawnOrb(player: Player, owned: Economy.Owned, at: Vector3): ()
	local tier = Data.tier(owned.tier)
	local model = World.buildBrainrot(tier, owned.mutation)
	model.Name = `Orb_{tier.name}`
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(at + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)))
	model.Parent = workspace
	local orb = {
		model = model,
		owner = player,
		tier = owned.tier,
		mutation = owned.mutation,
		expiresAt = os.clock() + TUNING.orbLifetime,
	}
	table.insert(TideCycle.orbs, orb)
	-- float + spin
	local conn
	conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		local t = os.clock()
		if model.Parent == nil or t > orb.expiresAt then
			conn:Disconnect()
			return
		end
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(at.X, at.Y + 4 + math.sin(t * 3) * 0.6, at.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 2, 0))
	end)
end

local function sweep(): ()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
		if #profile.owned >= 1 and not BasePad.isOnOwnPad(player) then
				local char = player.Character
				local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local at = if root ~= nil and root:IsA("BasePart") then root.Position else World.spawnPoint
				local rarest = twoRarest(profile)
				for _, o in rarest do
					if o == nil then
						continue
					end
					spawnOrb(player, o, at)
					-- remove that owned entry
					for i, owned in profile.owned do
						if owned.tier == o.tier and owned.mutation == o.mutation then
							table.remove(profile.owned, i)
							break
						end
					end
				end
				Economy.broadcastState(player)
				BasePad.refreshCollector(player)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Anyone touching an orb grabs it (validated server-side, bounded distance).
local function startOrbTouch(): ()
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		for i = #TideCycle.orbs, 1, -1 do
			local orb = TideCycle.orbs[i]!
			if now > orb.expiresAt or orb.model.Parent == nil then
				orb.model:Destroy()
				table.remove(TideCycle.orbs, i)
			else
				for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
					local char = player.Character
					local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if root ~= nil and root:IsA("BasePart") then
						local d = (root.Position - orb.model:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
						if d <= TUNING.orbPickupRadius then
							local profile = Economy.profileOf(player)
							if #profile.owned < TUNING.maxOwnedPerTier * Data.MAX_TIER then
								table.insert(profile.owned, { tier = orb.tier, mutation = orb.mutation })
								Economy.broadcastState(player)
								BasePad.refreshCollector(player)
								Economy.remotes.OrbTaken:FireAllClients(player.Name, orb.tier)
							end
							orb.model:Destroy()
							table.remove(TideCycle.orbs, i)
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function TideCycle.start(): ()
	TideCycle.wall = makeWall()
	startOrbTouch()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
		-- calm phase
		setPhase("calm", TUNING.tidePeriod)
		local t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < TUNING.tidePeriod - TUNING.tideWarning do
			local left = TUNING.tidePeriod - (os.clock() - t0)
			TideCycle.timeLeft = left
			task.wait(1)
		end
		-- warning phase: klaxon, rebroadcast so the client countdown ticks
		setPhase("warning", TUNING.tideWarning)
		t0 = os.clock()
		while os.clock() - t0 < TUNING.tideWarning do
			local left = TUNING.tideWarning - (os.clock() - t0)
			TideCycle.timeLeft = left
			Economy.remotes.TideState:FireAllClients("warning", left, TUNING.tidePeriod)
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
		-- sweep: animate the wall across the reef as a shrinking ring
		setPhase("sweep", 0)
		local radius = 140
		local wall = TideCycle.wall
		if wall ~= nil then
			wall.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			wall.Size = Vector3.new(radius * 2, 30, radius * 2)
			wall.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, World.WATER_Y + 12, 0)
			for step = 1, 30 do
				local r = radius * (1 - step / 30)

	local char = player.Character
